label: rem:bring-embeddable-knots
title: Bring-embeddable knots: genus-bounded table and per-knot witness targets for the depth correspondence
html:
Remark (Bring-embeddable knot table).

The QOU substrate selects the knots whose Seifert genus is bounded by Bring's surface genus (prop:knot-eigenbasis-complete, rem:knot-exhaustiveness):

  \mathrm{Knots}_{\mathrm{Bring}}
  \;:=\;
  \bigl\{ K \,:\, g(K) \;\leq\; 4 \bigr\}.

By the generation completeness theorem, a finite list of torus-knot generators combined with skein crossing changes generates this class. The recursive atom-knot atlas lists the canonical low-genus representatives.

Genus stratification and generators

The full enumeration of Bring-embeddable knots by genus appears in Table: Bring-embeddable knot table. Every Bring-embeddable knot derives from seven torus-knot generators:

  \{T(2, 3),\; T(2, 5),\; T(2, 7),\; T(2, 9),\; T(3, 4),\; T(3, 5),\; T(5, 2)\}

via skein crossing changes. These generators satisfy g(T(p, q)) = (p-1)(q-1)/2 \in [1, 4], and appropriate skein moves preserve the g \leq 4 bound.

Falsifiability and depth-2 witnesses

For each Bring-embeddable knot K with dominant cell \lambda_K in H_n(q) and shape parameter z_K \in \overline{\mathbb{Q}}^\times:

  [\mathrm{Vol}(K)] \;=\; \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\bigl( e_{\lambda_K}
  \cdot \mathrm{Li}_2^q(z_K) \bigr) \;\in\; \mathcal{P}_2 / \mathcal{P}_1.

If conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence holds, every entry in the principled atlas must satisfy:

  \mathrm{Vol}(K) \;\stackrel{!}{=}\; \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\bigl(
  e_{\lambda_K} \cdot \mathrm{Li}_2^q(z_K) \bigr).

A single counter-example falsifies the depth correspondence. We verified the figure-8 row (conj:bring-figure-eight-depth-2-witness), but confirming nodes like 5_2, 6_2, and 6_3 remains necessary. This verification entails identifying \lambda_K and z_K, and computing the projection e_{\lambda_K} as the explicit Goncharov-period witness (prop:explicit-central-idempotent).
